solution: Page 63 of the Bill 2024 10-K has the cumulative return graph. The graph is in Item 5. It starts at $100 on December 12, 2019.
At June 30, 2024, Bill shows $150. The S&P 500 Index shows $170.
$150 minus $170 is negative $20.
Negative $20 divided by $170 is negative 0.1176. Times 100 that is negative 11.76%.
Bill underperformed the S&P 500 Index by 11.76% from December 12, 2019 to June 30, 2024.

The "Comparison of Five-Year Cumulative Total Return" chart is on Document page 21 of the Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. 2023 10-K. The chart contains a table with data for Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. and the S&P 500 and Russell 2000 Index from 2018 to 2023.

In 2021, Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. had a value of $147.45. In 2023, that value was $114.49. The change is $114.49 minus $147.45 which equals negative $32.96. Negative $32.96 divided by $147.45 equals negative 0.2235. That is negative 22.35%.

In 2021, the Russell 2000 Index had a value of $172.90. In 2023, that value was $160.85. The change is $160.85 minus $172.90 which equals negative $12.05. Negative $12.05 divided by $172.90 equals negative 0.0697. That is negative 6.97%.
Negative 22.35% minus negative 6.97% equals negative 15.38 percentage points.
The percentage difference in cumulative total return between Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. and the Russell 2000 Index from 2021 to 2023 is negative 15.38 percentage points.
Page 2 of the Genesco 2024 annual report has the Total Return to Shareholders graph. The graph starts at $100 on February 2, 2019.
The table in the graph shows Genesco ending at $63.84 in 2024. The period is 5 years.
63.84 divided by 100 is 0.6384. 0.6384 to the power of one-fifth is 0.91416. 0.91416 minus 1 is negative 0.08584. Times 100 that is negative 8.584%.
Rounded to two decimal places, the CAGR is negative 8.58%.

Page 34 of the document has a table called "Land and Lot Position." The company has 21,000 lots under active contracts in 2024. Page 31 of the document has a Lot Sales table. The 2024 average lot price is $96,600 per lot.
75% of 21,000 lots is 15,750 lots. These go to D.R. Horton. 25% of 21,000 lots is 5,250 lots. These go to third-party customers.
D.R. Horton gets a 3% discount. 3% of $96,600 is $2,898. $96,600 minus $2,898 is $93,702 per lot. 15,750 lots times $93,702 equals $1,475,806,500.
Third-party customers pay $96,600 per lot. 5,250 lots times $96,600 equals $507,150,000.
The projected net residential lot sales revenue for FY2025 is $1,955.099 million.
Note 2 on page 97 of the Owens Corning 2024 Form 10-K has a net sales table for the twelve months ended December 31, 2024.
The Insulation segment, U.S. residential line shows $1,578 million. The Insulation segment, U.S. commercial and industrial line shows $809 million.
$1,578 million plus $809 million is $2,387 million. The table confirms $2,387 million as the Total United States figure for the Insulation segment.
The Insulation segment total net sales is $3,692 million.
$2,387 divided by $3,692 is 0.64653. Times 100 that is 64.653%.
Rounded, 64.65% of Insulation segment net sales came from the United States in the year ended December 31, 2024.
Page 55 of the Cohu 2024 Annual Report has the Consolidated Statements of Operations. The year ends December 28, 2024. Net sales is $401,779 thousand. Cost of sales is $221,485 thousand.
$221,485 minus $11,074.25 is $210,410.75 thousand. Adjusted Cost of sales.
$401,779 minus $210,410.75 is $191,368.25 thousand. Adjusted Gross Profit.
The adjusted Gross Margin is 47.63% of Net sales.
